captureScope: Explicit declared steps/layers/heads; every actual declared head/batch with complete QK/projection/layout/logits/mask inputs. Compact actual-call and full decoded-output identity receipts. No synthetic replacement or silent sample/drop.
captureOverhead: Designated proofs only: one head raw artifact pending, synchronous readback/serialization and admitted independent CPU oracle acknowledgement. Raw deleted only after bound verified ACK and sealed ledger; compact capture/hash ledger retained. capture_bound reports conservative one-head native transient bound; oracle RAM separately admitted. All ordinary E9 baselines are capture-off.
